sections.heading: 01 — INITIAL MANAGEMENT
sections.content: Assess ABCs, oxygen saturation, and establish IV access. Sit patient upright.

sections.heading: 02 — MEDICATION
sections.content: Administer Furosemide 40mg IV slowly. Monitor urine output.

sections.heading: 03 — WARNING
sections.content: Do not give beta-blockers in acute decompensated heart failure.

sections.heading: 01 — RECOGNIZE
sections.content: [UPDATED] This is an updated version of the ACS topic. Central chest pressure, heaviness, or pain radiating to the arm, jaw, back.
